At 5 months Theo is just about there -- Health Canada's window is around 6 months, so a few more weeks and you can start watching for the signs he's ready: sitting up with support, losing the tongue-thrust reflex, and showing interest in food. Confirm timing with his provider at the 6-month visit.

Want the full first-foods plan for Theo? Reply YES and I'll send it.
